items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that lawyer Hugh Macbeth still around? [INTERVIEWEE] He died and his nephew is the administrator.

ctx.x: Yeah, Los Angeles. She was in New Orleans at first, you know. She had a couple of children, I think, in Los Angeles. Or they went shortly after. I saw her one time in New Orleans.
Was that lawyer Hugh Macbeth still around?
He died and his nephew is the administrator.
